enonce.texte:
Instructions: Interview a classmate about their daily routine. Write 5 questions and their answers.

Example questions:

  • What time do you wake up?
  • Do you eat breakfast every day?
  • How do you go to school?
  • What do you do after school?
  • When do you go to bed?

questions.texte: Write a question about waking up.
questions.reponse: Example: What time do you wake up? Answer: I wake up at 6 AM.

questions.texte: Write a question about breakfast.
questions.reponse: Example: Do you eat breakfast every day? Answer: Yes, I do.

questions.texte: Write a question about transportation to school.
questions.reponse: Example: How do you go to school? Answer: I go to school by bus.

questions.texte: Write a question about after-school activities.
questions.reponse: Example: What do you do after school? Answer: I play football.

questions.texte: Write a question about bedtime.
questions.reponse: Example: When do you go to bed? Answer: I go to bed at 10 PM.

intitule: Create a Dialogue - Asking About Someone's Day

enonce.texte: Instructions: Create a dialogue (at least 8 exchanges) between two friends. One asks questions about the other's daily routine. Use question words and do/does.

questions.texte: Write a dialogue about daily routine.
questions.reponse: Example: A: Hello! How are you? B: I'm fine, thanks. A: What do you do in the morning? B: I wake up at 6 AM and eat breakfast. A: Do you go to school by bus? B: No, I don't. I walk to school. A: What do you do after school? B: I do my homework and then play football. A: When do you go to bed? B: I go to bed at 10 PM. A: That's nice!

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Write the question that corresponds to each answer. Use question words and do/does.

  1. Answer: I live in Douala. → Question: ______?
  2. Answer: She eats rice for lunch. → Question: ______?
  3. Answer: They play football on Saturday. → Question: ______?
  4. Answer: I wake up at 5 AM. → Question: ______?
  5. Answer: He goes to school by bike. → Question: ______?

questions.texte: Write a question for the answer: I live in Douala.
Write a question for the answer: She eats rice for lunch.

questions.reponse: When do they play football? / What do they do on Saturday?

intitule: Describe Your Daily Routine - Write a Paragraph

enonce.texte:
Instructions: Write a paragraph (6-8 sentences) describing your daily routine. Use the present simple, question words, and time expressions.

Hint: Include: what you do in the morning, during the day, and in the evening.

questions.texte: Write a paragraph about your daily routine.
questions.reponse: Example: I wake up at 6 AM every day. I eat breakfast at 6:30 AM. I go to school by bus at 7 AM. I have classes from 8 AM to 2 PM. I eat lunch at school. I return home at 3 PM. I do my homework in the evening. I watch TV at 9 PM. I go to bed at 10 PM.
